rows.note: For a road bend, 彎 is the all-purpose Cantonese noun.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 waan1 wai2 jiu3 maan6 maan6 zaa1

rows.note: Use 曲線 for a geometric or drawn curved line rather than a road bend.

example.english: The teacher asked us to draw a curve on the diagram.
example.traditional: 老師叫我哋喺圖上面畫一條曲線。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 hai2 tou4 soeng6 min6 waa6 jat1 tiu4 kuk1 sin3

rows.note: Use 身材曲線 for the attractive contours of a woman's body.

example.english: This dress really accentuates your body's curve.
example.traditional: 呢條裙好突出你嘅身材曲線。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 kwan4 hou2 dat6 ceot1 nei5 ge3 san1 coi4 kuk1 sin3
